#!/usr/bin/env bash
set +x
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
for init in "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" /root/.nvm/nvm.sh /home/rm/.nvm/nvm.sh; do
 if [[ -r "$init" ]]; then set +u; . "$init"; set -u; break; fi
done
python3 - "$@" <<'ADMIN_SEARCH_INSTALL'
import base64,gzip,hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time,signal,fcntl
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import urlopen,Request
PATCH=base64.b64decode('')
PATCH=gzip.decompress(PATCH)
if hashlib.sha256(PATCH).hexdigest()!='065f8e5e75bbb3f7e7cc57cc76211826ceb0ecc5f560dd6b002dffaf4249938a':raise SystemExit('Installer checksum mismatch')
FILES=['src/api/users/users.controller.ts','src/api/users/user-search.ts','src/views/users.ejs','src/views/partials/user-search.ejs']
RELEASE='admin-user-search-v1'
def run(args,**kwargs):return subprocess.run(args,check=True,**kwargs)
def process():
    rows=json.loads(run(['pm2','jlist'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15).stdout)
    found=[]
    for row in rows:
        env=row.get('pm2_env',{});root=Path(env.get('pm_cwd','/nonexistent'))
        if (root/'src/api/users/users.controller.ts').is_file() and (root/'src/views/users.ejs').is_file() and (root/'package.json').is_file():
            package=json.loads((root/'package.json').read_text())
            if all(key in package.get('dependencies',{}) for key in ['express','ejs','typeorm']):
                found.append({'id':row['pm_id'],'name':row['name'],'root':str(root.resolve()),'status':env.get('status'),'uptime':env.get('pm_uptime')})
    if len(found)!=1 or found[0]['status']!='online':raise RuntimeError('Expected exactly one online PM2 admin app. Nothing installed.')
    return found[0]
def check_patch(root,patch,reverse=False):
    cmd=['git','-C',str(root),'apply']+(['--reverse'] if reverse else [])+['--check',str(patch)]
    return subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode==0
def healthy():
    url=os.environ.get('RM_ADMIN_HEALTH_URL','https://admin.recruitmaster.net/auth/login')
    for _ in range(15):
        try:
            with urlopen(Request(url,headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache'}),timeout=3) as response:
                if response.status==200:return
        except Exception:pass
        time.sleep(1)
    raise RuntimeError('Admin login page is not responding')
def write_source(root,name,content,attrs):
    dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    temp=dest.with_name('.'+dest.name+'.admin-search-tmp');temp.write_bytes(content)
    os.chmod(temp,attrs.st_mode & 0o777 if attrs else 0o644)
    if os.geteuid()==0:
        owner=attrs or dest.parent.stat();os.chown(temp,owner.st_uid,owner.st_gid)
    os.replace(temp,dest)
def main():
    if sys.argv[1:] not in ([],['--check']):raise RuntimeError('Usage: bash installer [--check]')
    def interrupted(*_):raise RuntimeError('Installation interrupted')
    for sig in [signal.SIGINT,signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGHUP]:signal.signal(sig,interrupted)
    state=process();root=Path(state['root'])
    if not (root/'node_modules').is_dir() or not (root/'dist/index.js').is_file() or (root/'dist').is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('Existing regular admin build and dependencies required')
    lock=(root/'.admin-user-search-install.lock').open('a');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.admin-search-build-',dir=root.parent));backup=None;source_changed=False;dist_moved=False
    before={}
    try:
        patch=stage/'search.patch';patch.write_bytes(PATCH)
        if check_patch(root,patch):pending=True
        elif check_patch(root,patch,True):pending=False
        else:raise RuntimeError('Admin source differs from reviewed patch. Nothing installed; do not force it.')
        for name in FILES:
            file=root/name
            if file.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('Symlink source is not supported: '+name)
            before[name]=(file.read_bytes(),file.stat()) if file.is_file() else (None,None)
        healthy()
        print('Admin source compatibility and current health passed: '+state['name'],flush=True)
        if sys.argv[1:]==['--check']:
            print('Check only: no source/build changes, database requests or restarts.');return
        if not pending and (root/'dist/.admin-user-search-release').is_file() and (root/'dist/.admin-user-search-release').read_text()==RELEASE:
            print('Already published; no changes.');return
        shutil.copytree(root/'src',stage/'src')
        for file in [root/'package.json',*root.glob('tsconfig*.json')]:shutil.copy2(file,stage/file.name)
        (stage/'node_modules').symlink_to(root/'node_modules',target_is_directory=True)
        if pending:run(['git','apply',str(patch)],cwd=stage)
        print('Building admin in a separate directory; current app stays running...',flush=True)
        run(['npm','run','build'],cwd=stage,timeout=600)
        for name in ['index.js','api/users/user-search.js','views/partials/user-search.ejs']:
            if not (stage/'dist'/name).is_file():raise RuntimeError('Missing admin build output: '+name)
        (stage/'dist/.admin-user-search-release').write_text(RELEASE)
        for file in [stage/'dist',*(stage/'dist').rglob('*')]:file.chmod(0o755 if file.is_dir() else 0o644)
        if process()!=state:raise RuntimeError('Admin process changed during build; nothing installed')
        for name,(content,_) in before.items():
            current=root/name
            if (current.read_bytes() if current.is_file() else None)!=content:raise RuntimeError('Source changed during build; nothing installed')
        healthy()
        backup=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.before-admin-user-search-',dir=root.parent));backup.chmod(0o700)
        (backup/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'root':str(root),'processId':state['id'],'files':{k:v[0] is not None for k,v in before.items()}}))
        for name,(content,_) in before.items():
            if content is not None:
                target=backup/'source'/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(root/name,target)
        source_changed=True
        for name,(_,attrs) in before.items():write_source(root,name,(stage/name).read_bytes(),attrs)
        (root/'dist').rename(backup/'dist');dist_moved=True
        (stage/'dist').rename(root/'dist')
        run(['pm2','restart',str(state['id'])],capture_output=True,timeout=40)
        healthy()
        active=process()
        if any(active[k]!=state[k] for k in ['id','root','name']):raise RuntimeError('Admin process identity changed')
        print('Published: admin candidate/recruiter search. Backup: '+str(backup),flush=True)
        print('Open admin.recruitmaster.net/users. No migrations, email sending, ATS/backend restarts or dependency installation.',flush=True)
    except BaseException:
        if source_changed and backup:
            for name,(content,attrs) in before.items():
                if content is None:
                    if (root/name).is_file():(root/name).unlink()
                else:write_source(root,name,content,attrs)
            if dist_moved:
                if (root/'dist').exists():shutil.rmtree(root/'dist')
                shutil.copytree(backup/'dist',root/'dist',copy_function=shutil.copy2)
            run(['pm2','restart',str(state['id'])],capture_output=True,timeout=40)
            print('Previous admin source/build restored. Backup: '+str(backup),flush=True)
        raise
    finally:shutil.rmtree(stage,ignore_errors=True)
try:main()
except Exception as error:print('Admin search not installed: '+str(error),file=sys.stderr);sys.exit(1)

ADMIN_SEARCH_INSTALL
